conclusion: 48 of 48 simulated transfers succeeded across channels clean, mild, harsh at 0%, 3% independent frame loss, with payloads up to 6000 bytes (largest tested: 6000 bytes). Every trial succeeded, so the tested channels and loss rates are upper bounds on tolerated degradation rather than a measured cliff. Simulated wall time is a software benchmark, not screen time: the projected 60 fps screen time and projected net bit rate are reported separately for protocol planning.

summary.note: Simulated wall time measures the Python pipeline. Projected screen time = frames / 60 fps; projected net bit rate uses that screen time. Neither is a physical camera measurement.

title: End-to-end simulated transfer
